module origen_207228(
    output reg [7:0] keycode,
    output reg is_pressed,
    input PS2_DATA,
    input PS2_CLOCK,
    input clk
);

    reg [3:0] state;
    parameter READY = 4'b0000, GRAB = 4'b0001, PARITY = 4'b0010, DONE = 4'b0011;
    reg [7:0] data_buffer;
    reg parity;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case (state)
            READY: begin
                is_pressed <= 0;
                if (!PS2_DATA) begin
                    state <= GRAB;
                    data_buffer <= 0;
                    parity <= 0;
                end
            end
            GRAB: begin
                if (~PS2_CLOCK) begin
                    data_buffer <= {data_buffer[6:0], PS2_DATA};
                    parity <= parity ^ PS2_DATA;
                    if (state == GRAB && data_buffer[7:0] == 8'b11110000) begin
                        state <= PARITY;
                    end
                end
            end
            PARITY: begin
                if (~PS2_CLOCK) begin
                    if (parity == PS2_DATA) begin
                        state <= DONE;
                        keycode <= data_buffer[7:0];
                        is_pressed <= 1;
                    end else begin
                        state <= READY;
                    end
                end
            end
            DONE: begin
                state <= READY;
                is_pressed <= 0;
            end
            default: state <= READY;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
